name: EUMETNET MeteoAlarm feeds (all participating countries)
gives: official severe-weather warnings (CAP) for each participating European country, including Portugal and the UK

why.quote: (robots.txt on feeds.meteoalarm.org is empty, so it sets no rule)
why.basis: robots.txt (empty, HTTP 200). The terms page www.meteoalarm.org/en/live/page/terms-of-use is a JavaScript application and returned only 'this app doesn't work properly without JavaScript enabled', so the terms are a gap

interface: GET https://feeds.meteoalarm.org/api/v1/warnings/feeds-{country} (for example feeds-portugal) returns JSON of CAP warnings (about 119 KB for Portugal). No key.
notes: Already read and collected here as meteoalarm-pt (sources/meteoalarm; the status board calls its licence 'the source's terms'). This entry is only the Europe-wide extension: the same feed pattern per country. register/sources.json is mid-merge (see gaps), so I could not check how meteoalarm-pt is recorded there. Terms still unread by a person; attribution to the issuing national service is the usual condition (not confirmed). Rate limits not found.
